Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly broadened the task by treating Julia’s prior betrothal to Quintus Servilius Caepio as a “binding union” sufficient to qualify him as Cornelia’s child-in-law. This misinterprets “child-in-law” (which refers to the spouse of one’s child) and introduces an unsupported alternative, diverting from the correct, singular answer (Pompey the Great). The error stems from conflating betrothal with marriage and directing subsequent steps to verify this incorrect inclusion.
